preconditions.description: The number of workers n is between 1 and 5000.
The numerator a and denominator b of the parameter k satisfy 1 <= a <= b <= 100000.
The length of the string s is equal to the number of workers n.
All characters in the string s are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c not in 'trygub' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain the characters 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', or 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output consists of an integer c followed by c space-separated characters.
The first element of the output is the number of obtainable job categories.
The remaining elements of the output are the obtainable job categories in lexicographical order.
